platform: SolidEdge Cloud Platform (SECP) — Engineering Truth OS

targetReferenceSystem.name: Industrial / Aircraft Electronic Control Unit (ECU) Reference Assembly

wireTypes: M22759/16 PTFE-insulated stranded copper (18 AWG power, 22 AWG signals)

thermalManagement.coolingMethod: Conduction to chassis + Natural/Forced ambient convection

inScope: Rigid PCB Canonical Model integrity and layout rule checking
DC steady-state electrical nodal analysis (MNA) & power balance
Copper trace DC resistance and voltage drop under thermal operating points
Wiring harness interconnect parity, pinout consistency, and wire ampacity
MCAD 3D clearance, standoff alignment, and enclosure keepout boundaries
Lumped-parameter steady-state component junction temperature estimation
Cryptographic SHA-256 Merkle tree evidence binding and deterministic hashing
Fail-Closed acceptance gates and adversarial fault injection verification
explicitlyOutOfScope: Full aircraft flight dynamics, aerodynamic loading, and airframe CFD
DO-178C software compilation binary verification and object code structural coverage
DO-160 Section 22 direct and indirect lightning strike transient electromagnetic simulation
3D spatial Navier-Stokes conjugate heat transfer in vacuum / low-pressure environments
Dynamic random vibration modal FEA fatigue simulation (MIL-STD-810H / DO-160 Section 8)
Official regulatory certification sign-off from civil aviation authorities (FAA, EASA, CAAC)

qualificationVerdictCategories.NOT_ASSESSED: Requirements defined but no analysis or tests executed.
qualificationVerdictCategories.VERIFICATION_FAILED: One or more mandatory engineering thresholds breached.
qualificationVerdictCategories.EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: Missing required artifacts, digests, or unapproved assumptions.
qualificationVerdictCategories.QUALIFICATION_BLOCKED: Critical gap or unresolvable cross-domain conflict detected.
qualificationVerdictCategories.QUALIFIED_WITH_LIMITATIONS: Acceptable within tightly defined operational envelopes with declared exclusions.
qualificationVerdictCategories.QUALIFIED_WITHIN_DECLARED_SCOPE: Fully backed by verified engineering evidence within the declared operational envelope.
